evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies `invalidateblock` in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` to reject invalidating genesis and return errors on disconnect failures.
rationale: Fixes `invalidateblock` returning success when block disconnection fails and leaves the chain partially rolled back. Reporting success on a partial failure is misleading to automated callers, though `invalidateblock` is primarily an administrative and testing interface.
